short_description: The classic 2D action platformer BioMenace returns with enhanced graphics and refined gameplay. Fight your way through a city ravaged by dangerous mutants, rescue hostages, find secrets and rack up points. Locate the secret lab behind this attack and prevent Dr. Mangle from taking over the world!
steam_categories: Single-player; Steam Achievements; Full controller support; Adjustable Difficulty; Keyboard Only Option; Playable without Timed Input; Save Anytime; Steam Cloud; Steam Leaderboards; Includes level editor; Family Sharing
